execution.disclosure_required: A later run may send only the selected public excerpt, its listed question identifiers, and the structured result schema to the named remote model.

result_contract.bounded_repair: For an invalid verbatim span, request one span-only repair with verdict and confidence locked; if that fails, request one fresh single-leaf regrade. Preserve every valid leaf and never select among multiple valid attempts.
result_contract.verbatim_span_rule: Each nonempty verbatim span must occur exactly in the excerpt supplied for that leaf.
